title: Hardware Acceleration of Fully Quantized BERT for Efficient Natural Language Processing
selection_reason: FQ-BERT fully quantizes BERT weights, activations, softmax, layer normalization and intermediates for an FPGA accelerator on ZCU102/ZCU111, achieving 7.94x weight compression and 3.18 fps/W (28.91x over CPU, 12.72x over GPU); a concrete quantization-plus-hardware contribution to Transformer inference on edge devices.
venue: Design, Automation and Test in Europe
